verdict.rationale: Firebase provides Cloud Functions triggered by background events and Cloud Scheduler jobs, which enables autonomous background automations (e.g., data changes, scheduled jobs) without a server, and this is well documented. However, this is general backend automation infrastructure rather than an AI-native/agentic automation framework — there's no evidence of AI-agent-specific autonomous workflows, agent orchestration, or persistent AI agents running in the background. missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-oriented autonomous background workflows (not just generic serverless triggers), independent/hands-on confirmation of scheduled/event automations working reliably, and any agentic orchestration layer built on Functions.
